A group of LEGO minifigures, known as the Master Builders, have the unique ability to build things without the need for instructions. They are a creative and innovative group, who often meet in the "Dog" part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues and come up with new ideas.

However, their creative ways have caught the attention of Lord Business, who sees their ability to build without instructions as a threat to his plans for a perfectly ordered world. In response, Lord Business has formed the Super Secret Police, whose mission is to hunt down and capture the Master Builders. Once captured, the Master Builders are taken to the "ymns of Tamil saints," where they are likely held against their will.

In medieval era artworks and texts on dancing Shiva found in Nepal, Assam, and Bengal, the deity is sometimes shown as dancing on his vahana (animal vehicle) Nandi, the bull. Further, he is regionally known as Nartesh, a name that reflects his role as a powerful and energetic dancer.
